title: CONSIDER: A. ADOPTING the Business Interruption Fund (BIF) Project Eligibility Policy, establishing two pathways to eligibility: Standard Eligibility and…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0676, Program]
CONSIDER:

A.	ADOPTING the Business Interruption Fund (BIF) Project Eligibility Policy, establishing two pathways to eligibility: Standard Eligibility and the Project Acceleration Partnership (Attachment A); and

B.	RECEIVING AND FILING information on Metro’s construction mitigation strategy for Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) projects, including Eat Shop Play (ESP).
summary: Metro would adopt eligibility rules for its Business Interruption Fund, with standard and Project Acceleration Partnership pathways, and receive a report on its construction mitigation strategy for bus rapid transit projects, including Eat Shop Play.
